reviews_h2: What people are saying about the electrical

reviews.author: Brendan Oliver
reviews.text: Always polite, professional, and with an attitude that gets the job done (and done right). They've been taking care of my big headaches for our commercial and residential jobs for years now, and never with a failure or callback!

reviews.author: Justin Fischbach
reviews.text: They were quick to return my call so points there but I told them the work required a bucket truck. Because of this I was told my scheduled date would be a longer wait. The scheduled date they were on time, but no bucket truck. I was told they would have to reschedule me and that it would be later that day or the next that I would hear on a new date; still waiting three weeks later. Don't waste your time and schedule someone that will communicate what the job is.

reviews.author: Vanessa Brown
reviews.text: Professional, courteous, prompt, friendly and fair pricing. We have been repeatedly pleased with their work and efforts!

reviews.author: Susan Buchan
reviews.text: On time, pleasant, reasonably priced and competent. Dustin has done a lot of work for me and it's always been a great experience.

reviews.author: Glen Haddock
reviews.text: Great work. Have used before. Technicians are very efficient and knowledgeable. Replaced all my garage lights and 3 ceiling fans in my home. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Sharon Simmons
reviews.text: I had an electrical problem today. Did not have power to parts of my house. I called Mr. Brumbaugh and he was here within 10 minutes. He told me it was a problem with Dominion Energy. He called them and they were here minutes later & fixed the problem. So thankful that Mr. Brumbaugh was willing to come on a Sunday & found the problem right away. I would highly recommend him.

reviews.author: melisa kurtz
reviews.text: Great service, professional, friendly staff. I can't say enough. The price is excellent. I will be always call on them.
